message.content:
A classic lasagna typically includes:

| Ingredient | Typical Amount (per serving) |
|------------|------------------------------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | 2–3 sheets (or one box of no-boil noodles) |
| **Ground beef** | 1/2 lb (about 225 g) |
| **Italian sausage** | 1/2 lb (optional, for extra flavor) |
| **Onion** | 1 small, finely chopped |
| **Garlic** | 2 cloves, minced |
| **Canned crushed tomatoes** | 1 cup (240 ml) |
| **Tomato paste** | 2 tbsp (30 ml) |
| **Water or broth** | 1/2 cup (120 ml) |
| **Olive oil** | 1 tbsp (15 ml) |
| **Salt & pepper** | To taste |
| **Dried oregano** | 1 tsp (5 ml) |
| **Dried basil** | 1 tsp (5 ml) |
| **Ricotta cheese** | 1 cup (240 g) |
| **Mozzarella cheese** | 1 cup shredded (240 g) |
| **Parmesan cheese** | 1/4 cup grated (60 g) |
| **Egg** | 1 (for binding ricotta mixture) |
| **Fresh parsley** | 1 tbsp, chopped (optional) |

### Optional Extras
- **Spinach** or other leafy greens (1 cup, wilted)
- **Mushrooms** (sliced, sautéed)
- **Red pepper flakes** (for heat)
- **Pesto** (swirled into sauce)

These ingredients form the base for a traditional meat lasagna. Adjust quantities based on your appetite and whether you prefer a vegetarian version (omit meats). Enjoy!
